metadata.description: Skills that stop an agent from claiming work it did not finish, test Android apps on real phones, and turn past papers into ranked revision sheets.

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Verification gate before any work is reported done: the asks rebuilt from the user's words, file:line evidence, a blind subagent audit, and the project's own checks.

plugins.name: android-device-test
plugins.description: Test an Android app on a real phone over adb: install, tap real UI elements, kill the network and the process, report pass or fail with screenshots and logcat.

plugins.name: exam-sheet
plugins.description: Turn a syllabus and past papers into one printable revision page, chapters ranked by the marks they actually carried, every topic an exam-ready answer with a diagram.
